conf.description: Suricata alert / other: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-ingest-pipeline).

conf.comment: suricata / alert / other. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic ingest pipeline decodes this downstream (custom fast.log grok/dissect ingest pipeline (no stock integration)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).

functions.description: record why this pipeline does not parse
tag the dataset before Elastic parses _raw
